programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E04
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: The Green Heart of Croatia
programme.sub-title: At the Banks of River Sava
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river's delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans
programme.desc: Terence McDonagh is a drug- and gambling-addled detective in post-Katrina New Orleans investigating the killing of five Senegalese immigrants.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen (\"Green Book\") stars as an undercover FBI agent who has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: After an ex-cop (Michael Rooker, \"Guardians of the Galaxy\") finds himself caught up in a battle between Japanese mobsters and local thugs, he discovers that he was framed by a corrupt cop.

programme.title: Game of Death
programme.desc: Secret Ops agent Marcus is sent to Detroit to take out an arms dealer and the head of the hedge fund that is financing him. His CIA backup has other plans and turns on him and it's a fight to survive in a hospital.

programme.title: True Justice: Deadly Crossing
programme.desc: When an influx of violent and ruthless heroin dealers descend on Seattle, Elijah Kane (Steven Seagal) leads an elite undercover squad of cops to bring them to justice.

programme.title: True Justice: Dark Vengeance
programme.desc: With the killer seemingly caught the team believe the case is closed, when another woman is found dead matching the m.o. of the serial killer. Sarah unwittingly becomes the target of the real killer.

programme.title: True Justice: Street Wars
programme.desc: The \"E\" investigation runs smoothly until Seattle P.D.'s top brass order Kane (Steven Seagal) to act as security for eccentric documentary filmmaker.

programme.title: True Justice: Lethal Justice
programme.desc: Kane, having dealt with his own post war stress, is called to help his war comrade (Ryan Robbins) as he suffers from P.T.S.

programme.title: True Justice: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Kane and his team set out to take down the Yakuza once & for all.

programme.title: True Justice: Urban Warfare
programme.desc: Kane's Black Ops past is causing uncertainty in the SIU team's future.

programme.title: True Justice: Vengeance is Mine
programme.desc: Following the attack on his precinct, Kane buries his friends and sets his sights on avenging their deaths. He assembles a new team and follows the trail across the border to Vancouver.

programme.title: True Justice: Blood Alley
programme.desc: Elijah Kane Is on a new mission for the government after being promised that the CIA will provide information about who put out a hit on his previous team.

programme.title: True Justice: Violence of Action
programme.desc: The Ghost is buying and Kane sets out to find out what to get him closer to The Ghost.

programme.title: True Justice: Angel of Death
programme.desc: An undercover cop gets closer to his nemesis. He decides to let a trusted agent go into the field, but has doubts about whether she has what it takes to complete the mission.

programme.title: True Justice: Dead Drop
programme.desc: Kane begins to realise that his contact in the CIA may not be the ally he first seemed.

programme.title: True Justice: One Shot One Life
programme.desc: As Kane gets close to Magellan, Lynch's handler, FBI Agent Sloan calls on all hands to find and arrest Kane and his team.

programme.title: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: After a journalist discovers his identity, a former Weather Underground activist goes on the run.

programme.title: The Professor and the Madman
programme.desc: Professor James Murray begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Minor.

programme.desc: A group of Navy SEALs comes to learn the identity of their target: Osama bin Laden.

programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: Quand Alice va au Pays des Merveilles, une chose est sûre : elle ne sait jamais quelle aventure elle va vivre ! Tomber dans le ciel, cueillir des fleurs du silences, traverser la vallée de la nuit, chasser des coucous… Lorsque quelque chose la tracasse dans le monde réel, ou au contraire, lorsqu'elle est de super humeur, elle n'hésite jamais à aller rendre visite à son meilleur ami Lewis ! Il est toujours là pour la réconforter, la surprendre, la faire rire… et c'est réciproque !

programme.title: Alice & Lewis

Mais il faut y glisser des objets qui correspondent aux goûts de la Reine. Dinah ne s'en soucie guère, trop pressée de retrouver son skate, et aggrave la situation auprès de la Reine qui le confisque pour de bon… Avec l'aide d'Alice et Lewis, Dinah va apprendre à mieux connaître sa tante pour trouver ce qui lui plaît vraiment et ainsi récupérer son skate.

programme.desc: Thomas insiste pour utiliser son chasse-neige pendant une livraison alors qu'il n'y a pas de neige, ce qui le distrait et cause des problèmes à ses amis. programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !

programme.desc: Lorsque Gordon laisse la responsabilité des livraisons à Thomas pour la journée, Thomas voit cela comme sa chance de prouver qu'il est un bon chef. Au fur et à mesure que des problèmes surgissent, il constate que diriger ne se résume pas à être un patron.

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !

programme.desc: Thomas est choisi pour livrer les roses très appréciées de Monsieur Haut-de-Forme au Festival des Fleurs annuel de Sodor, mais quand une mouffette l'asperge, son odeur et sa précipitation pour résoudre le problème menacent de faire dérailler toute la journée !

programme.title: Le Monde de Barney
Barney's World
programme.desc: Voici Barney, le dinosaure violet qui chante, danse et répand de l'amour autour de lui ! Cette nouvelle série d'animation se déroule dans la plaine de jeux de la ville, où Barney s'amuse en compagnie des dinosaures Billy et Baby Bop, ainsi que de leurs trois jeunes amis. À travers leurs aventures créatives ou amusantes, Barney aide les enfants en bas âge à comprendre leurs émotions et leurs tracas. Il leur explique comment s'apprécier, comment aimer et traiter les autres avec respect.

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Les Dino rancheurs rejoignent leur oncle Jack sur l'île des Dino pour y passer l'été et y vivre des aventures passionnantes! Jon est impressionné par son oncle et veut lui montrer qu'il est téméraire, lui aussi. Mais lors de leur toute première mission, ses efforts vont se retourner contre lui. Alors que Min et Miguel gèrent la situation avec calme, la ferveur de Jon ne fait qu'aggraver le chaos!

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: "Les rancheurs réceptionnent une caisse de "fruits boulets". Le seul problème, c'est que la coque est si rigide qu'il est presque impossible de les manger. Miguel dévoile alors son invention, le "mixeur-o-tron", un gadget qui permet de transformer ces fruits durs comme de la pierre en une délicieuse boisson. Mais au moment de déguster leur victoire, une quetzal géante vient voler leur caisse!

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Les Dino Ranchers partent pour l'aventure de leur vie sur la mythique île des Dino, un monde perdu foisonnant de dinosaures inédits et de mystères. Aux côtés de leur oncle Jack, les enfants Cassidy bravent des jungles hostiles et relèvent des défis extrêmes. Loin de leur ranch, ils devront faire preuve de solidarité, de courage et d'ingéniosité pour protéger ce territoire sauvage.

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Oncle Jack et Jon ont récolté des bana-cocos! Ils savent que pour rentrer, ils doivent éviter la Vallée des Essaims car les libéllules qui y vivent raffolent de ces fruits! Jack et Jon empruntent un chemin plus sûr, mais les Trouble-corne débarquent à bord de leur ballon et leur dérobent toute la cargaison! Atticus met le cap sur la Vallée des Essaims, sans se douter du danger qui les attend!

programme.title: Baby Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Les Baby Looney Tunes sont adorables et vivent tous ensemble dans une grande maison victorienne sous l'oeil bienveillant de Mémé.Il y a d'abord Baby Bugs, chef de bande dans l'âme. Prenant son rôle très à coeur, il veille déjà sur ses amis Baby Titi et Baby Grosminet, dont la tendresse laisse cependant présager d'un avenir des plus agités. programme.desc: En l'an 3021, dans une station spatiale située quelque part entre Mars et Jupiter dans la Voie lactée, Ella Ryder, 8 ans, part avec ses amis pour de passionnantes aventures de découverte. programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: Quand Alice va au Pays des Merveilles, une chose est sûre : elle ne sait jamais quelle aventure elle va vivre ! Tomber dans le ciel, cueillir des fleurs du silences, traverser la vallée de la nuit, chasser des coucous… Lorsque quelque chose la tracasse dans le monde réel, ou au contraire, lorsqu'elle est de super humeur, elle n'hésite jamais à aller rendre visite à son meilleur ami Lewis ! Il est toujours là pour la réconforter, la surprendre, la faire rire… et c'est réciproque !

programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: À l'école, une nouvelle élève se lie d'amitié avec Bastien et Carole qui l'invitent à tous leurs jeux. Alice s'inquiète de perdre sa place au sein du groupe. Déstabilisée, elle file au Pays des Merveilles retrouver Lewis… … mais découvre que Bastien et Carole sont là eux aussi ! D'abord enthousiaste, Alice déchante vite : ses deux amis s'entendent à merveille avec Lewis. Mais comment est-ce possible ? Et comme un fait exprès, Alice découvre qu'un énorme danger plane sur le Pays des Merveilles. Et si, à cause de la présence de Bastien et Carole, le Pays des Merveilles venait à disparaître ? Et si, tout cela n'était qu'un cauchemar ?

programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode spécial en deux parties, Alice découvre un Pays des Merveilles qu'elle n'aurait jamais pensé voir un jour ! Un Pays des Merveilles où la Reine n'est plus Reine mais une paysanne cultivant ses carottes, où les jumeaux sont les gardiens du château protégeant le Roi qui n'est autre que… Lewis ! programme.desc: Lorsque le ballon pieuvre destiné au festival de Sodor se détache, les locos ont toutes des interprétations différentes de ce qu'elles voient. Thomas doit rétablir la vérité et sauver le festival.

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !
Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: La fusée qui s'est envolée dans l'espace la saison dernière est de retour sur terre, et Thomas est impatient d'aider à la repêcher ! Même si Salty lui dit que la meilleure façon d'aider est parfois de se tenir à l'écart du travail des autres, Thomas s'intègre dans l'équipe mais ne peut pas résister à l'envie de voir la fusée. Ses va-et-vient causent le chaos... jusqu'à ce que la fusée dérive dans la baie, où elle est vraiment difficile à récupérer. En fin de compte, Thomas trouve la solution et apporte l'aide nécessaire !

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !
Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Quand Kenji prend le mauvais wagon, Thomas se propose de lui apporter le bon. Mais une succession de détails manqués lui font rater Kenji de peu à chaque fois. Enfin, avec l'aide de ses amis, Thomas obtient les détails nécessaires et peut rattraper Kenji juste à temps.

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !
Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.sub-title: Le blues de la petite locomotive bleue
programme.desc: "Après que Thomas se réveille du "mauvais côté du hangar",il lutte pour être une loco heureuse car il pense que c'est ce que tout le monde attend de lui. Riff et Jiff l'aident à réaliser que personne ne peut être heureux tout le temps et qu'on est aimé par ses amis tout de même.

programme.desc: Voici Barney, le dinosaure violet qui chante, danse et répand de l'amour autour de lui ! programme.title: Lucas l'araignée
Lucas the Spider
programme.desc: Lucas découvre un morceau de gâteau et décide d'organiser une fête surprise pour Fine-Mouche.

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !
Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Quand ils sont chargés de préparer des bottes de foin pour une énorme livraison, Terence et Carly ajoutent un peu de plaisir au travail en construisant la plus haute tour de foin jamais construite.

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !
Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Lorsque les locos ont la journée pour jouer, Percy accepte à contrecœur d'arbitrer leur course-relai. Mais à chaque course, les équipes réfutent les décisions de Percy. Percy démissionne et s'enfuit. Thomas, Diesel et leurs coéquipières doivent être de bons joueurs et mettre leur compétition de côté pour respecter leur ami.

programme.title: Thomas et ses amis : Tous en avant !
Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Quand Thomas et Percy doivent transporter un wagon de bananes qui porte soit-disant malheur, Thomas semble avoir de la malchance partout où il va. L'attitude positive de Percy aide Thomas à voir la chance dans chaque scénario, brisant le mythe de la malédiction pour une livraison réussie.

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Jon, Min, et Miguel ont hâte d'explorer leur nouveau QG. Mais l'inauguration devra attendre un peu car Grand Rex, le prédateur le plus redouté de l'île vient gâcher la fête. Oncle Jack parvient à mettre tout le monde à l'abri dans l'enceinte du QG et peut donc procéder au test des installations. Mais un duo de compsognathus a volé la clé du système semant le chaos dans toute l'île.

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Les rancheurs font une sortie en mer pour tester le Turbo-jungle mais pour échapper à Écaille-de-foudre, un redoutable mosasaure, ils vont se réfugier dans une grotte. Les rancheurs sortent de leur cachette et tombent sur une plésiosaure qui cherche désespérément à mettre son oeuf à l'abri. Les jeunes explorateurs vont devoir déjouer les attaques d'Écaille-de-foudre pour sauver l'oeuf et sa maman.

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Les Dino Ranchers partent pour l'aventure de leur vie sur la mythique île des Dino, un monde perdu foisonnant de dinosaures inédits et de mystères. Aux côtés de leur oncle Jack, les enfants Cassidy bravent des jungles hostiles et relèvent des défis extrêmes. Loin de leur ranch, ils devront faire preuve de solidarité, de courage et d'ingéniosité pour protéger ce territoire sauvage.

programme.title: Dino Ranch : L'île des explorateurs
Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: La première impression peut être trompeuse, la preuve avec cette maman tortue protectrice qui prend le Turbo-jungle pour un prédateur et se lance à sa poursuite. La pauvre tortue se blesse et Min décide de la ramener au QG pour la soigner. Pendant ce temps-là, Jon et MIguel placent les bébés tortues dans un enclos afin de les surveiller, mais Bella, la petite tortue intrépide, a d'autres projets.

programme.title: Baby Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Les Baby Looney Tunes sont adorables et vivent tous ensemble dans une grande maison victorienne sous l'oeil bienveillant de Mémé.Il y a d'abord Baby Bugs, chef de bande dans l'âme. Prenant son rôle très à coeur, il veille déjà sur ses amis Baby Titi et Baby Grosminet, dont la tendresse laisse cependant présager d'un avenir des plus agités. Et en la matière Baby Taz affiche, lui aussi, de sacrées dispositions! Autre fort caractère, Baby Daffy s'impose comme le plus capricieux de la bande. Quant à Baby Coyote, ses petites mésaventures lui feront rapidement comprendre que rivaliser avec un Baby Bip Bip n'est décidément pas de tour repos...

programme.desc: Alice et Lewis sont surpris de découvrir que Dodson est ami avec la nièce de la Reine, Dinah ! Ils comprennent vite que le dodo s'est fait passer pour un grand aventurier qui n'a peur de rien auprès de l'ado. A cause d'une bourde d'Alice, Dinah découvre que Dodson lui a menti. Elle se fâche et rompt leur amitié. Face à la détresse du dodo, Alice et Lewis aident Dodson à rattraper le coup et à prouver à Dinah qu'il est bien à la hauteur de ses récits, grâce à divers stratagèmes et donc d'autres mensonges….

programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode spécial en deux parties, Alice découvre un Pays des Merveilles qu'elle n'aurait jamais pensé voir un jour ! Un Pays des Merveilles où la Reine n'est plus Reine mais une paysanne cultivant ses carottes, où les jumeaux sont les gardiens du château protégeant le Roi qui n'est autre que… Lewis ! Et le pire c'est qu'il ne reconnaît plus Alice et la considère comme une intruse qu'il faut chasser et à qui il faut reprendre sa clé ! Le Pays des Merveilles serait-il en train de se transformer en un Cauchemardesque Pays des Merveilles ?

programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: C'est le jour des photos au Pays des Merveilles : chaque habitant a droit à son portrait officiel. La Reine décide de poser sur un trône doré. Mais l'arrivée de Chester au moment de la photo provoque chez elle une allergie qui la fait éternuer et ruine la coloration dorée. Alice et Lewis doivent trouver rapidement une solution de rechange... Et si Chester pouvait se transformer en trône doré ? Malheureusement, le matou a un mystérieux hoquet qui détraque toutes ses transformations...

programme.title: Alice & Lewis
programme.desc: Quand Alice va au Pays des Merveilles, une chose est sûre : elle ne sait jamais quelle aventure elle va vivre ! Tomber dans le ciel, cueillir des fleurs du silences, traverser la vallée de la nuit, chasser des coucous… Lorsque quelque chose la tracasse dans le monde réel, ou au contraire, lorsqu'elle est de super humeur, elle n'hésite jamais à aller rendre visite à son meilleur ami Lewis ! Il est toujours là pour la réconforter, la surprendre, la faire rire… et c'est réciproque !

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably – launching their fishing boat into the sea using a bulldozer.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: Ben’s travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in the region.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: Ben’s meets an Orchardist and Food Innovation specialist. They have a shared vision to make all natural varietal – led apple juice, using the best technology in the world. He also checks out over 30 varieties of figs grown in the Mediterranean type climate of Hawkes Bay.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both healthy and versatile, highlighting a commitment to local agriculture and sustainability.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold direct to Kiwis.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: Ben experiences the Ruapehu’s region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening. He meets a sixth generation farmer who has turned a remote wilderness into a thriving eco-tourism and fine dining destination, alongside an award winning chef.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sight"
programme.desc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. People with good vision are sometimes called "eagle eyed", but eagles can see a fish from many dozen metres away.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Hearing"

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Touch"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Taste and Smell"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Superhuman Senses"
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"

programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Racetime

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone

programme.title: Danger Decoded
programme.desc: Journey to the planet's most unforgiving places from scorching deserts to frozen icy seas.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. Moving the national animal of Bulgaria across international borders is something powers high up a.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. It’s a temporary holding facility while Four Paws find a long-term sanctuary equipped to care for a lion in his condition as he will need specialized care and pain medication for the time that he lives.He’s about to make the journey to his forever home. After weeks of crate training the veterinarians who specialize in large animal transports Marc and Juno are relieved that Ivan- Asen doesn’t need to be tranquilized to be moved into the crate. He walks in willingly. After beginning a life in such hellish conditions, Ivan-Asen is on the road to recovery. The team first have to navigate the Balkan Mountain ranges in the middle of winte.

programme.desc: We go to the mail room for viewer requests as Terry and Larry take a look into famous scenes from Yellowstone, SWAT, Fast and Furious.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test things they never got to from other episodes. Pull up a chair and get ready for leftovers, and a surprise guest.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: Grenades, propane tanks, and a bathtub, all adds up to some big tests of the popular comic book character.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: From Polar, to James Bond, to Lethal Weapon, Terry loves action movies and is putting some of the best ones to the test.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife
programme.desc: Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals. The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.sub-title: Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
programme.desc: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.sub-title: Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.sub-title: Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart
programme.desc: Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.sub-title: Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.sub-title: Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
programme.desc: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Ditch the dough. Chef Frankie Celenza makes a protein-packed pizza the whole family will love. This is chicken pizza like you've never tried at home - until now.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza stretches one whole chicken and a pack of ramen to make a rich and warm Chicken Paprikash dish, swapping egg noodles for buttered ramen and using the seasoning packet to boost the sauce.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza levels up a drive-thru classic fish filet sandwich with ultra-crispy fried cod, homemade tartar sauce and pimento cheese. Plus, five reasons not to toss your leftover pickle brine.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: A comforting pub classic made easy. Chef Frankie Celenza turns inexpensive chuck roast and rich stout beer into a hearty British Beef and Ale Pie with a waterproof hot water crust. Plus, how to cook once for comfort food twice.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza elevates a packet of ramen for a hearty yet dainty salad. The dish features crispy croutons atop a crunchy napa cabbage with fruit, nuts and leftover chicken. Plus, a reminder to make your own salad dressing. You can do it!

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza turns 2 lbs of ground beef into a moist meatloaf and pan-seared meatloaf burgers with slaw. Plus, a tip on storing burgers that your future self will thank you for.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Make the perfect bacon, egg and cheese sandwich for yourself or for a crowd with Chef Frankie Celenza's tips on homemade condiments and the secret to crispy bacon every time.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza makes cozy, comforting Matzo Ball Soup entirely from scratch, almost. Rotisserie chicken is the struggle hero of this classic recipe, searing the skin to create rich schmaltz. Plus homemade matzo balls that float and never sink.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.sub-title: A Big Braised Chuck Roast Sandwich aka The Wichita
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what's the difference between a Philly Cheesesteak and a French Dip Sandwich? Chef Frankie Celenza takes a bite out of both and invents a whole new, affordable, delicious sandwich: The Wichita!

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
programme.desc: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: The Best Fish You're Not Eating
programme.desc: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
programme.desc: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

programme.desc: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Ribs are a lifestyle, and Chef Dale's living it up with smoky beef shorties in tangy red wine glaze, Miami-style pork ribs dripping in bacon-guava BBQ, spicy baked beans, and killer key lime caramel cones. Grab some napkins!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.sub-title: The Art of Open Fire Cooking
programme.desc: Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Dale skewers ribeye, salmon, smoky eggplant dip, and grilled peaches. Food on sticks never tasted better!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Dale's turning up the heat! Carolina Reaper wings hotter than your ex, sweet-chili NY strip steak, smoky grilled chipotle Texas toast, and ancho-gochujang pineapple skillet cake for dessert. Bring some water!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drink with a charred banana.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Dale fires up the tandoor grill, turning out juicy chicken thighs, smoky shrimp with Old Bay yogurt, crispy cauliflower, and a silky mango lassi dessert topped with crunchy candied pistachios. Tandoori done right!
